LanguageData.RHAH_ArmedDemand_LetterText:
A group of famine ratkin has gathered around our colony, demanding food.

"We need food. Squeak. Give us a meal and we will go."

They demand food equivalent to {0} simple meals.
LanguageData.RHAH_ArmedDemand_Attack: {0}'s group did not receive the food they demanded and has begun attacking.
LanguageData.RHAH_ArmedDemand_Paid: The food demanded has been delivered in full. The visitors have accepted it and are preparing to leave.
LanguageData.RHAH_ArmedDemand_Unavailable: Food equivalent to {0} simple meals is still needed: there is not enough allowed food, or the visitors cannot collect it.
